text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Take Aaron and his sons with him, the vestments, the anointing oil, the bull of sin offering, the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;
text_cn: “你领亚郎和他的儿子一同前来，带着祭衣、圣油、作赎罪祭的公牛犊，两只公绵羊和一筐无酵饼；

text_en: and assemble the whole congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
text_cn: 并召集全体会众到会幕门口。”

text_en: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him. When the congregation was assembled at the entrance of the tent of meeting,
text_cn: 梅瑟便依照上主所吩咐的做了。当会众集合在会幕门口后，

text_en: Moses said to the congregation, “This is what the Lord has commanded to be done. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟就对会众说：“这是上主吩咐应做的事。”

text_en: Then Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward, and washed them with water.
text_cn: 梅瑟遂叫亚郎和他的儿子前来，用水洗了他们；

text_en: He put the tunic on him, fastened the sash around him, clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod on him. He then put the decorated band of the ephod around him, tying the ephod to him with it.
text_cn: 然后给亚郎穿上长衣，束上带子，穿上无袖长袍，套上“厄弗得”，束上“厄弗得”带子，将“厄弗得”系紧。

text_en: He placed the breastpiece on him, and in the breastpiece he put the Urim and the Thummim.
text_cn: 再给他安上胸牌，在胸牌内放上“乌陵”和“突明”。

text_en: And he set the turban on his head, and on the turban, in front, he set the golden ornament, the holy crown, as the Lord commanded Moses.
text_cn: 以后将礼冠戴在他头上，在礼冠前面安上金牌，即圣牌。全照上主对梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: Then Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and consecrated them.
text_cn: 以后梅瑟拿了圣油，傅了会幕和其中所有的一切，祝圣了这一切；

text_en: He sprinkled some of it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its utensils, and the basin and its base, to consecrate them.
text_cn: 又将一些油七次洒在祭坛上，又傅了祭坛和祭坛的一切用具，盆和盆座，祝圣了这一切；

text_en: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him, to consecrate him.
text_cn: 然后把圣油倒在亚郎头上，傅了他，祝圣了他。

text_en: And Moses brought forward Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and fastened sashes around them, and tied headdresses on them, as the Lord commanded Moses.
text_cn: 此后梅瑟叫亚郎的儿子前来，给他们穿上长衣，束上带子，给他们缠上头巾：全照上主对梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: He led forward the bull of sin offering; and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bull of sin offering,
text_cn: 随后梅瑟把作赎罪祭的公牛犊牵来，亚郎和他的儿子按手在赎罪祭的公牛犊头上，

text_en: and it was slaughtered. Moses took the blood and with his finger put some on each of the horns of the altar, purifying the altar; then he poured out the blood at the base of the altar. Thus he consecrated it, to make atonement for it.
text_cn: 把牛宰了，梅瑟取了血，用手指抹在祭坛四周的角上，洁净了祭坛；将剩下的血倒在祭坛脚旁：这样就祝圣了祭坛，为祭坛行了洁净礼。

text_en: Moses took all the fat that was around the entrails, and the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat, and turned them into smoke on the altar.
text_cn: 此后，梅瑟将贴在内脏上所有的脂肪、肝叶、两肾和两肾上的脂肪，放在祭坛上焚烧；

text_en: But the bull itself, its skin and flesh and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as the Lord commanded Moses.
text_cn: 牛犊的皮、肉和粪，都在营外用火烧了：全照上主对梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: Then he brought forward the ram of burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram,
text_cn: 此后，梅瑟把作全燔祭的公绵羊牵来，亚郎和他的儿子按手在羊头上，

text_en: and it was slaughtered. Moses dashed the blood against all sides of the altar.
text_cn: 把羊宰了，梅瑟把血洒在祭坛四周；

text_en: The ram was cut into its parts, and Moses turned into smoke the head and the parts and the suet.
text_cn: 然后把羊切成碎块，将头和碎块以及板油全焚烧，

text_en: And after the entrails and the legs were washed with water, Moses turned into smoke the whole ram on the altar; it was a burnt offering for a pleasing odor, an offering by fire to the Lord , as the Lord commanded Moses.
text_cn: 内脏和腿，用水洗净；梅瑟将整个公绵羊放在祭坛上焚烧：这是全燔祭，是中悦上主的馨香火祭，全照上主对梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: Then he brought forward the second ram, the ram of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram,
text_cn: 此后，梅瑟将第二只公绵羊，即作祝圣祭的公绵羊牵来，亚郎和他的儿子按手在羊头上。

text_en: and it was slaughtered. Moses took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron’s right ear and on the thumb of his right hand and on the big toe of his right foot.
text_cn: 把羊宰了，梅瑟取些血抹在亚郎的右耳垂，右手拇指和右脚大趾上。

text_en: After Aaron’s sons were brought forward, Moses put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears and on the thumbs of their right hands and on the big toes of their right feet; and Moses dashed the rest of the blood against all sides of the altar.
text_cn: 梅瑟又叫亚郎的儿子前来，把血也抹在他们的右耳垂，右手拇指和右脚大趾上；剩下的血，梅瑟都洒在祭坛的四周。

text_en: He took the fat—the broad tail, all the fat that was around the entrails, the appendage of the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat—and the right thigh.
text_cn: 随后取出脂肪、肥尾、贴在内脏上所有的脂肪、肝叶、两肾和两肾上的脂肪，以及右后腿；

text_en: From the basket of unleavened bread that was before the Lord , he took one cake of unleavened bread, one cake of bread with oil, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.
text_cn: 又由放在上主面前的无酵饼筐内，取出一块无酵饼，一块油饼和一块薄饼，放在脂肪和右后腿上；

text_en: He placed all these on the palms of Aaron and on the palms of his sons, and raised them as an elevation offering before the Lord .
text_cn: 将这一切放在亚郎和他的儿子们的手上，在上主前行奉献的摇礼。

text_en: Then Moses took them from their hands and turned them into smoke on the altar with the burnt offering. This was an ordination offering for a pleasing odor, an offering by fire to the Lord .
text_cn: 然后梅瑟由他们手中接过来，放在祭坛的全燔祭品上焚烧：这是祝圣祭，是中悦上主的馨香火祭。

text_en: Moses took the breast and raised it as an elevation offering before the Lord ; it was Moses’ portion of the ram of ordination, as the Lord commanded Moses.
text_cn: 以后，梅瑟拿了牺牲的胸脯，在上主前行了奉献的摇礼，这是由祝圣祭的公绵羊中，梅瑟应得的一份，有如上主对梅瑟所吩咐的。

text_en: Then Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron and his vestments, and also on his sons and their vestments. Thus he consecrated Aaron and his vestments, and also his sons and their vestments.
text_cn: 以后，梅瑟拿了些圣油和祭坛上的血，洒在亚郎和他的衣服上，他的儿子和他儿子的衣服上：这样就祝圣了亚郎和他的衣服，他的儿子和他儿子的衣服。

text_en: And Moses said to Aaron and his sons, “Boil the flesh at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and eat it there with the bread that is in the basket of ordination offerings, as I was commanded, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it’;
text_cn: 梅瑟又对亚郎和他的儿子说：“你们应在会幕门口煮祭肉，也在那里吃这肉和筐内放的祝圣祭的饼，有如上主曾吩咐我的：亚郎和他的儿子应当吃。

text_en: and what remains of the flesh and the bread you shall burn with fire.
text_cn: 剩下的肉和饼，你们应用火烧了。

text_en: You shall not go outside the entrance of the tent of meeting for seven days, until the day when your period of ordination is completed. For it will take seven days to ordain you;
text_cn: 七天的工夫，你们不可出会幕门口，直到你们的受职礼满期的那一天，因为你们的受职礼是七天。

text_en: as has been done today, the Lord has commanded to be done to make atonement for you.
text_cn: 照今天所做的，上主还叫照样去做，好为你们赎罪。

text_en: You shall remain at the entrance of the tent of meeting day and night for seven days, keeping the Lord ’s charge so that you do not die; for so I am commanded. ”
text_cn: 七天七夜，你们应住在会幕门口，遵守上主的礼规，以免死亡，因为上主这样吩咐了我。”

text_en: Aaron and his sons did all the things that the Lord commanded through Moses.
text_cn: 凡上主藉梅瑟所吩咐的事，亚郎和他的儿子都做了。
